name: Daiyan

skills.name: Plucking Strings
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 6 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to them.

skills.name: Absolute Tuning
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 6 tiles, dispels 1 buff, and deals Physical damage equal to 150% of attack to them.

skills.name: Qing Shang Harmony
skills.description: Gains 3 stacks of Tuning, as well as Pitch Perfect for 1 turn. Gains 1 instance of Extra Command.

skills.name: Ethereal Resonance
skills.description:
Selects 1 enemy target within 6 tiles, dealing Physical damage equal to 190% of attack. For every 1 stack of Tuning, reduces this skill's cooldown by 1 turn.

After attacking, consumes all stacks of Tuning and gains 1 stack of Tuning permanently, up to a maximum of 3 stacks.

skills.name: Swift Harmony
skills.description:
At the start of the action, gains 1 point of Confectance Index and 1 stack of Tuning. When performing an active attack against a target not protected by Cover, gains 1 point of Confectance Index.

Before taking targeted damage, if the number of Tuning stacks is greater than 2, launches Interception, dealing light ammo Physical damage equal to 150% of attack and 4 points of Stability Damage, and permanently gains 1 stack of Tuning. This can be triggered once per turn.

If the number of Tuning stacks is greater than 3, increases damage dealt by 20%.

fortification.effect: If the target has no buffs to dispel when during the attack, gains 1 stack of Tuning after the attack.
Increases the number of Tuning stacks gained by 3.
Increases the stack limit of permanent Tuning by 3 stacks.

If the number of Tuning stacks is greater than 5, increases damage dealt by 40% instead. Additionally Stability Damage dealt by Interception increases by 2 points, and the initial damage multiplier increases by 30%.
When the number of permanent Tuning stacks reaches max, ignores 15% of Cover damage reduction when attacking Exposed enemies.
For every 1 enemy unit that dies on the field, gain 1 stack of Tuning permanently.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Echoing Melody
keys.effect: When Daiyan has Tuning, increases mobility by 1 tile.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Unfulfilled Dreams
keys.effect: Gains 3 points of Confectance Index at the start of the battle.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Hazewalker's Melody
keys.effect: For each point of additional mobility before the attack, critical rate increases by 10%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Serene Serenade
keys.effect: If Daiyan's mobility is higher than the target's, gains 1 stack of Tuning before using an active attack.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Squad Broken
keys.effect: For every 3 stacks of Tuning, dispels 1 additional buff when using the active skill Absolute Tuning.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Lasting Legacy
keys.effect: After using Qing Shang Harmony, if a kill occurs in this turn, recovers 20% max HP and 2 points of Stability Index.

keys.name: Common Key - Shattering Stone and Silk
keys.effect: CRIT +5.0% / At the start of the action, gains Movement Up I for 1 turn. This has a cooldown of 1 turn.

keys.name: Expansion Key
keys.effect: For each stack of Permanent Tuning held, ignores 10% of the target's DEF when attacking. At the end of the action, gains 2 stacks of Tuning, and for each stack of Permanent Tuning held, increases Confectance Index by 1 point

keys.name: Expansion Key tier 2
keys.effect:
When using the Ultimate skill Ethereal Resonance and launches Interception, gain 1 stack of permanent Tuning.

At the end of a round, if no Interception was performed, gain 2 stacks of permanent Tuning and increase the next active attack's damage multiplier by 150% and Stability damage by 4 points.

After using the Ultimate skill Ethereal Resonance, perform 1 additional attack on the target. For each stack of permanent Tuning possessed, this attack deals Physical damage equal to 100% of attack and 1 point of Stability damage.
